notes.title: v0.91 is live!
notes.content:
• Automatic save more robust.
• "P" for pause more robust.
• Moonlight is brighter
• Torch is brighter and wider
• Interior slightly brighter
• Revised colliders, should now be near on impossible to get stuck?
• Dropping toys is more predictable. All toys now dropped at feet.
• Portraits play/pause by "E" or mouseclick rather than by looking at them.
• Portrait audio stays on while you are in that room, allowing exploration
• PS3, Xbox and Ouya controllers - reduced jerkiness if frame rate drops. 
• Xbox and PS3 controllers have been tested on OSX and Windows.
• There may be a loss of compatibility with saved games from v0.8, but it's all in the name of progress :)

notes.title: NEW UPDATE
notes.content:
Just finishing the final checks on an update that includes the following fixes:

1. Stick controller settings now correct on default and can be customized.
2. Phone booth rings just once per game.
3. “C” now for crouch, along with the previous L-CTRL.
4. Arrow keys now clone WASD.
5. Walk and run speeds are just a l-i-t-t-l-e faster on walk, bit more on run.
6. Right Shift as well as the previous Left Shift now activate running.
7. Moonlight and torch brightness upped again – torch beam widened and range extended just a little, too.
8. F2 no longer quits the game.
9. ESC now brings up options to return to menu, or 'cancel' to return to game.

We're also testing our new Save and Pause, and our new Moon and Torch brightness level controllers - hopefully ready very soon!

notes.title: FEATURES FOR NEXT UPDATES:
notes.content:
[list][*]A save function is being added - no checkpoints, just save!
[*]A pause function is being added, meanwhile "P" pauses the player.
[*]Stick and keys control mapping.
[*]High-res textures are now finished, ready to be implemented. We're learning, we used one standard res for the first version!
[*]Lighting levels boosted.
[*]Walk and run speeds increased slightly.
[*]Random left hand wave fix.
[*]Phone booth will ring on first approach only.
[*]"C" for crouch will be added, not just "L_CTRL" and "Z" (which 100% of those I surveyed said was the way to go - my own kids!)
[*]Arrow keys will clone WASD.

After that:
[*]custom controls for moonlight, torchlight and audio.

[/list]
